note: vm.encoded.js is the VM encoder's output for source.js with vmOptions, the leading disassembly comment block removed (the committed corpus format). Each other file is the outer encoder's output over that VM output (comment block included) with target node and one listed option. Math.random was replaced by the seeded PRNG used by cff-loop-return (mulberry32: state += 0x6d2b79f5, then the standard mulberry32 output), reset to the seed before each encoder. Regenerating with the same encoder revisions, options and seed reproduces the bytes.
